title_zh: 政策工具与企业发展案例交叉索引
author: 许丙南
boundary_note: This crosswalk records public mechanisms from official case pages and maps them to proposed policy and enterprise-development interfaces. It does not claim local adoption, legal equivalence, partnership, funding, performance or procurement approval.

cases.enterprise_development_question: How can a startup or supplier show a prospective public client what its system does, what data it touches and where feedback goes?
cases.jingzhang_interface: Require a plain-language pilot card before a public-space or enterprise-service test: purpose, data boundary, accountable operator, current state, non-AI equivalent and complaint route.
cases.boundary: A public register is a transparency layer; it is not a safety case, procurement decision or resident consent record.

cases.enterprise_development_question: How can procurement and service teams compare an AI supplier's purpose, limits, human review and remedy path before a pilot expands?
cases.jingzhang_interface: Add an algorithm preflight record to enterprise-service and public-space pilots, linking purpose, affected service, review owner, stop condition and redress route.
cases.boundary: The Amsterdam mechanism is not Chinese legal compliance and does not settle local procurement, secrecy or personal-information requirements.

cases.enterprise_development_question: How can small firms test safety and explainability before exposing a product to a real public workflow?
cases.jingzhang_interface: Use the Zhongzhi Garden test room as a booked, human-led assurance window with model card, reproducible test note, red-team record, takeover drill and rollback.
cases.boundary: AI Verify is a testing and assurance mechanism, not a certification, procurement approval or permission to test residents without consent.

cases.enterprise_development_question: How can companies and public teams receive usable community feedback without making an account, device or digital fluency a condition of access?
cases.jingzhang_interface: Pair the contribution wall and online decision ledger with staffed paper, walk-in and multilingual channels; publish which feedback changed the product or policy.
cases.boundary: Digital participation cannot replace in-person access, and an open-source platform does not by itself prove representative participation or positive outcomes.

cases.enterprise_development_question: What minimum record helps a public buyer, supplier and auditor agree on purpose, ownership, data, alternatives and incident handling?
cases.jingzhang_interface: Make purpose, owner, data, human review, alternatives, limits, incidents, update date and accountable contact mandatory fields in every pilot card.
cases.boundary: The UK standard is a public-sector transparency reference, not a Beijing statutory requirement or a substitute for local law and procurement review.

cases.enterprise_development_question: How can research, talent, public-service demand and company growth connect without turning a district proposal into an unsupported招商承诺?
cases.jingzhang_interface: Define a named, reviewable interface among university questions, startup support, public test windows, enterprise service and global exchange; each stage must have an owner and exit condition.
cases.boundary: The Seoul example does not establish a Jing-Zhang partnership, funding source, institutional mandate or implementation commitment.
